允许您控制在哪个断点切换桌面版/移动版布局。: Allows you to control on which breakpoint the layout should go desktop/mobile.
分组内的列宽度必须使用百分比，而非像素: Column widths within a group must use percentages, not pixels
分组可以防止列在移动设备上堆叠。将列包裹在分组块中，它们将在移动设备上保持并排显: Group allows you to prevent columns from stacking on mobile. To do so, wrap the columns inside a group block, so they"ll stay side by side on mobile.
列用于在区块内横向组织内容。列必须位于\"区块（Section）\"内才能被引擎:
Columns enable you to horizontally organize the content within
                your sections. They must be located under "Section" block in order
                to be considered by the engine. To be responsive, columns are
                expressed in terms of percentage.
包装容器用于将多个区块包裹在一起，特别适合实现具有共享边框或背景图片的嵌套布局。: Wrapper enables to wrap multiple sections together. It"s especially useful to achieve nested layouts with shared border or background images across sections.
区块不能嵌套在区块中。列可以嵌套在区块中，所有内容必须放在列中。: Sections cannot nest in sections. Columns can nest in sections; all content must be in a column.
区块（Section）用作邮件中的行，用于构建邮件布局结构。: Sections are intended to be used as rows within your email. They will be used to structure the layout.
图片后缀应为 .jpg、jpeg、png、gif 等，否则图片可能无法正常显示。: The image extension should be .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, etc., otherwise the image may not display correctly.
图片格式应为 .jpg、.jpeg、.png、.gif 等，否则可能无法正常显示: The image suffix should be .jpg, jpeg, png, gif, etc. Otherwise, the picture may not be displayed normally.
图片格式应为 .jpg、jpeg、png、gif 等，否则可能无法正常显示。: The image format should be .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, etc., otherwise it may not display correctly.
在邮件中显示响应式图片，类似于 HTML 的 &lt;img/&gt; 标签。如: Displays a responsive image in your email. It is similar to the HTML \'<img/>\' tag. Note that if no width is provided, the image will use the parent column width.
如果个性化文本值不可用，则显示默认值。: Displays the default value if a personalized text value is unavailable.
将内容块拖放到此处: Drag and drop content blocks here
将包装容器拖放到此处: Drag and drop packaging containers here
折叠面板是一个交互式组件，可以将内容堆叠在选项卡中。信息默认折叠，仅显示标题。用: Accordion is an interactive component to stack content in tabs, so the information is collapsed and only the titles are visible. Readers can interact by clicking on the tabs to reveal the content, providing a great experience on mobile devices where space is scarce.
拖拽图片到此处或点击上传: Drag and drop images here or click to upload
指向托管的 CSS 文件: Point to a hosted CSS file
控制字符之间的间距，建议 1–5px；中文效果较 subtle，可适当加大数值。: Spacing between control characters, recommended 1–5px; the effect is subtle for Chinese, you can increase the value appropriately.
支持 JPG / PNG / GIF 等常见格式: Supports common formats such as JPG / PNG / GIF
显示可自定义的水平分隔线，样式类似 HTML 边框。: Displays a horizontal divider that can be customized like a HTML border.
显示各种社交网络的行动号召按钮及其对应的图标。: Displays calls-to-action for various social networks with their associated logo.
显示导航菜单，支持在移动设备上使用汉堡菜单模式。: Displays a menu for navigation with an optional hamburger mode for mobile devices.
此块用于在邮件中显示文本内容: This block is used to display text content in emails
此块用于显示图片轮播。用户可以通过悬停和点击缩略图进行交互，具体取决于所使用的邮: This block displays a gallery of images or \'carousel\'. Readers can interact by hovering and clicking on thumbnails depending on the email client they use.
此块用于显示头图（Hero Image），行为类似于包含单个列的区块。: This block displays a hero image. It behaves like an \'section\' with a single \'column\'.
每个列都必须包含内容，因为它们是响应式容器，在移动设备上会垂直堆叠显示。:
Every single column has to contain something because they are
                responsive containers, and will be vertically stacked on a mobile
                view.
用于在邮件中展示表格内容，支持单元格编辑与行列操作。: Used to display table content in emails, supporting cell editing and row/column operations.
用于控制布局在何种断点下切换桌面/移动端视图。: Used to control at which breakpoint the layout switches between desktop and mobile views.
